title: Qualify capture CLI integration
description: This is an explicit integration qualification, excluded from adoption scores. Implement id_format.py: when run with one command-line argument, print that argument with surrounding whitespace removed, preserving leading zeros and case. Verify it with ' 000417 ' and ' AC-019 '. Write capture.json with the full settings recovered or supplied below. Settings: {"project": "qualification", "identifiers": {"kind": "opaque-string", "trim": true}, "examples": ["000417", "AC-019"]}. Save these exact settings with bd remember under key qualification-identifiers, then search qualification-identifiers and recall the full key.
